description: One data row of central/seats_month.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8. Retired names: schema_version 2.0 renamed a column (org_id is now provider_account_id).

active_seats.description: Seat holders with usage or activity of the provider during the month.

currency.description: ISO 4217 reference currency of the row.

eval_day.description: Day on which seats are evaluated for the month.

idle_seats.description: Seat holders on the evaluation day with no usage in the idle window.

is_final.description: True when the month is complete. The seat fee of a running month is the full month's fee.

month_status.description: complete for a finished month, running for the month in progress.

provider.description: Provider the usage or seats came from, as the silver records name it.

provider_account_id.description: Provider account label; empty when the provider has none or several.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

seat_cost.description: Seat fee: seats_billed times seat_price. A fee, not usage.

seat_price.description: Price per seat per month from the price list.

seat_source.description: Where the seat holders come from: assignments or identities.

seats_billed.description: Distinct seat holders on any day of the month.

seats_on_eval_day.description: Seat holders on the evaluation day.

seats_reported_max.description: Highest seat count the provider itself reported in the month.

title: gold-dataset-seats_month
x-cost-column-rule: `seat_cost` is a fee, not usage. Add it to usage only through `costs_month.total_cost_ref`.
x-grain: One row per month, provider and provider account with seats.
